core.lastAnswer: The decision border is dominated by regime penalties overriding technical confirmations, with RSI POSITION serving as the primary gatekeeper for borderline cases. Hair-thin passes (avg gap -3.63) are consistently rejected when regime penalties combine with RSI extremes, despite strong EMA STACK signals. Threshold modifiers (lesson, chase) are decisive in border cases, suggesting the gate is finely tuned to prevent false signals during regime transitions. Hard blocks show regime chop as an absolute veto trigger, indicating regime detection is the system's strongest protective layer.

lessons.pattern: EMA STACK is the dominant confirm factor but RSI POSITION is the primary gatekeeper for border cases — ev: EMA STACK appears in all boundary cases (avg ±20.03), but RSI POSITION is the main opposing factor (avg -9.37) and appears in shadow-veto evidence as overriding EMA confirms
lessons.action: Monitor RSI extremes closely when EMA signals align with regime penalties; consider RSI as a tie-breaker for ±3 score decisions
lessons.label: MODEL

lessons.pattern: Regime penalties consistently override technical confirmations in hair-thin passes — ev: All shadow-vetos show regime-5 penalty combined with RSI pressure causing rejection despite EMA stack confirms; hard blocks show regime chop as veto trigger
lessons.action: Implement regime-override protocol for scores between -5 and +5; require additional confirmation if regime is chop
lessons.label: MODEL

lessons.pattern: Boundary cases are consistently hair-thin (avg gap -3.63) and driven by threshold modifiers — ev: 94 cases in boundary band (avg gap -3.63), lesson modifier (+8) appears in all GENIUSUSDT cases, chase modifier (+6) in GUSDT cases
lessons.action: Track lesson/chase modifier accumulation separately from base scores; flag when modifiers push borderline cases into decision zone
lessons.label: MODEL

lessons.pattern: Hair-thin passes with regime and RSI surcharges are veto-prone — ev: Shadow veto rate at gap 0-1: 2/2 hair-passes vetoed (GUSDT LONG 11:53 & 11:47), both with regime-5 and RSI-11.25 overrides despite EMA+20 confirms
lessons.action: Watch for regime-chop + extreme RSI combos near threshold; consider tightening regime modifier during high choppiness
lessons.label: MODEL

lessons.pattern: Short-side boundary cases are regime-dependent lesson modifiers — ev: All 7 GENIUSUSDT SHORT candidates scored -36 with gap -2, passing due to lesson+8 offsetting regime-5 penalty, no RSI opposes
lessons.action: Monitor lesson modifier strength in regime-penalized short setups; if lesson surcharge weakens, expect border rejects
lessons.label: MODEL

lessons.pattern: Chop regime blocks are absolute and widespread — ev: 797 REGIME blocks in 12h; 6 pairs (LIT/FIL/AVA/BCH/LSK/AAVE) vetoed for path efficiency <16% below threshold
lessons.action: Treat regime-chop as hard stop; optimize path efficiency thresholds for high-chop assets
lessons.label: MODEL
